_doc: Curated recurring songs 李豆沙 performs, so song-lane identification is DETERMINISTIC instead of depending on the flaky LLM song-hint + text search (which mis-guessed 《屑屑》 as 快乐崇拜/穷开心 and lost it entirely, 2026-07-07). If >=2 fingerprint lines appear in the window ASR, that song's netease LRC is pinned into the alignment pool; ranking still proves it by real match ratio, so a wrong pin is harmless (ranked out). Add a song here once its netease id is confirmed against the actual performance.
